high_level_description: This image is a map titled "Ethnic Composition of Modern-Day Ukraine in 1875," which focuses on the territory of the Russian Empire at that time. The map uses different colors to represent various ethnic groups: Yellow: Ukrainians Red: Russians Blue: Jews Pink: Poles Additionally, there are smaller color-coded areas representing other ethnic groups: Purple: Belarusians Green: Tatars Beige: Romanians Dark Red: Bulgarians Light Blue: Greeks Gray: Germans The
